description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff statistics with the diff --stat-count option. It sets up various test scenarios to verify how Git reports line changes and file change counts under different conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expecting success, takes a description and a shell script block.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and reports differences.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, indicating all tests are complete.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Changes the mode of files for testing purposes.
